# 回程等级：消耗恰是不再回程，恢复可以无界地变慢 / Return grades: consumption is exactly a dependence that never returns, and recovery can slow without bound

## 主张 Claim

在依存网上，某步成立的依存在其后 p 步之内再被满足，为在 p 步内回程；条件上每个依存都如此，为在 p 步周期内更新；每个依存都在以后某步再被满足，为回程。等级有序：更新蕴含一步周期内更新；p 步内更新蕴含任何更长周期内更新，也蕴含回程；回程的条件不被消耗。消耗恰是某个依存不再回程。RelationalRenewal 中既不更新也不消耗的季节性条件，在两步周期内更新，不在一步内更新。恢复可以无界地变慢：一个间隔越来越长地再被满足的条件总会回程、从不被消耗，但没有任何周期长度能界定它的回程。周期层面的读法扩展逐步读法：形成在 p 步周期内更新，当它参与的每个条件都在 p 步内更新；事件侵蚀 p 步，当它在某步汲取某条件，而一个当时或此前被满足的依存此后 p 步都不被满足。侵蚀一步恰是逐步的侵蚀；周期越长记入越多；在某个周期内更新的形成不消耗，它的事件也不侵蚀该周期。两步周期下，短暂下降与在不活跃时被断裂的维持者都被记入；加码之后条件不再回来，加码事件对每个周期都侵蚀。不用伦理前提，也不用 Lean 公理。 / On a web of dependence, a dependence holding at a step returns within p steps when the condition meets it at one of the next p steps; a condition is renewed within p when every dependence on it does so, and it returns when every dependence on it is met at some later step. The grades are ordered: renewal implies renewal within one step; renewal within p implies renewal within any longer cycle and implies return; a condition that returns is not consumed. Consumption is exactly a dependence that never returns. The seasonal condition of RelationalRenewal, neither renewed nor consumed, is renewed within two steps and not within one. Recovery can slow without bound: a condition met again after ever longer gaps always returns and is never consumed, yet no cycle length bounds its return. Readings over cycles extend the stepwise readings: a formation renews over cycles of p when every condition it participates in is renewed within p, and its event undermines for p steps when it draws on a condition at a step after which a dependence met then or before stays unmet for the next p steps. Undermining for one step is exactly undermining at the step; a longer cycle credits more; a formation renewing over some cycle is not consuming, and none of its events undermines for that cycle. Over cycles of two, a dip and a keeper broken while inactive are credited; after an escalation the condition never returns, and the escalating event undermines for every cycle. No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used.

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- 依存网的可观测量如 becoming-dependence-dynamics 所设；回程按自然数步计。 / The observables of the web are those of becoming-dependence-dynamics; return is counted in natural-number steps.
- 周期读法与逐步读法一样，只读事件所汲取的条件，并且 draws 不带数量。 / Like the stepwise readings, the cycle readings read only the conditions an event draws on, and draws carries no amount.

回程等级区分的是一次运行中依存被再满足的时间。实际条件属于哪一等级、哪种周期适合一种读法，以及恢复变慢是否预示损失（生态学所谓临界变慢），都是应用与经验问题。 / The grades distinguish when dependence is met again in one run. Which grade an actual condition has, which cycle suits a reading, and whether slowing recovery signals a coming loss (what ecology calls critical slowing down) are application and empirical questions.
